title: Operation Prato as an official armed forces operation
summary: Aldo Rebello tells of Operation Prato as an official armed forces operation, about 1977 at Pará, Brazil, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: The operation took place. It was an official operation led by the armed forces to monitor these phenomena in the state of PA.

plain: Aldo Rebello, presented on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former defence minister of Brazil, talks about Operation Prato, a military effort in 1977 in Pará, a state in northern Brazil. Reading from the operation's official report, he says it really took place and was an official armed forces operation set up to monitor strange phenomena in the state. If so, it would mean Brazil's military formally investigated these sightings.
